description: Renovate is the single owner of dependency updates for this repo; keep repository-level (UI) Dependabot disabled.
Covers: GitHub Actions pins, the Helm chart dependency in charts/*/Chart.yaml, and container image tags in chart values.

A Helm dependency bump will fail the vendored-dependencies check until charts/ is re-vendored, because this repo commits the resolved archives and Renovate only edits Chart.yaml. That failure is the intended behaviour: run helm dependency update on the branch and commit the result.
First-party image tags are release pins managed by their own repository's release process, not third-party dependencies, so they are deliberately not managed here.

packageRules.description: The AFK bot image is first-party; its tag moves when that repo cuts a release.

description: The server image carries the world through a one-way door: Bedrock upgrades a world in place on first load and an older server cannot reopen it.
Reviewed on its own rather than inside the weekly batch, so the decision to walk through that door is never incidental to an unrelated update.
The backup job names its image as a bare `image: repo:tag` string rather than the repository/tag pair the helm-values manager recognises, so nothing would watch it.
That is the exact dependency that already broke once, when the image it previously used was retired from Docker Hub and stopped pulling at all.
